name: Shounen no Kuni no Shoujo Alice
original_name: 少年の国の少女アリス
source:
It's a world where only boys exist. Suddenly girl Alice appears in such world. Main character is captivated by her presence and is fully at her mercy. Soon he starts to become bolder.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
这是一个只有男孩存在的世界。突然，女孩爱丽丝出现在这样的世界里。主角被她的存在所吸引，并完全听从她的摆布。很快他开始变得更加大胆。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/06/vn-of-month-december-2007-dies-irae.html]vndbreview[/url]]
